description: §15.10.1 / §15.11.1 (S459 M1) — ONE component scope for a by-value prop: after `${ let label = "S" }` the later markup text reads the local (S, not the caller's L), and a later handler WRITE `onclick=${() => label = "Z"}` writes the local — it is NOT E-COMPONENT-PROP-WRITE (the local is not the prop). Before S459 the markup read L while `r()` returned S, and the handler write was falsely refused.
rationale: §15.10.1: "From the point of declaration onward in the same scope, the local binding shadows the prop." §15.11.1: "A local declaration, parameter or loop binder named like the prop is not the prop (§15.10.1 Shadowing) and is writable."
